stall.label: the baker is a recorded character
the baker has bread for sale

stall.note: A new seller with stock: the baker becomes a character and her bread items she owns.

rounds.text: A new stall at the edge of the square: a woman with flour in her hair sets out loaves under a cloth. "Two coins a loaf, three for a pair," she says, "and they won't be this warm tomorrow."

arguments.name: Mira the baker
arguments.description: A young baker with a new stall at the edge of the square.

arguments.name: Loaf of bread
arguments.properties: A meal for one; restores a little strength when eaten.

buy.note: The purchase: money first (the hero has none, so the transfer is refused), and the bread stays with the baker.

rounds.text: It is empty. Mira watches your hand come up with nothing and shrugs, not unkindly. "Come back when the mill pays you." She folds the cloth back over the loaves.
